newsitem.title: UK: Associated British Ports to take charge.
newsitem.headline: Associated British Ports to take charge.

text.p: Britain's Associated British Ports Holdings Plc said on Tuesday it would take a charge, before tax relief, of up to 3.0 million stg in its 1996 accounts for its withdrawal from a venture with Powell Duffryn Plc.
The port operating company said it planned to withdraw from the 50-50 venture, Universal Pipe Coaters Ltd, and added that Powell Duffryn might take over as 100 percent owner.
"UPC has been losing money in the recent past. This is not a core activity for Associated British, who do not provide the management of the joint venture," the firm said in a statement.
For its part, Powell Duffryn said the venture's losses did not change its view of a "satisfactory" group outcome for the year as a whole.
Associated British shares rose 4.0p to 310.5 by 0915 GMT, while Powell Duffryn stayed unchanged at 403.5p.
